clips.title: The story
paras: Shenthul sends a promising Horde rogue to Sludge Fen to contact an agent hidden among the Venture Company. The Shattered Hand has spent a year placing Taskmaster Fizzule inside the company’s drilling grounds, where he watches their plans.

The Shattered Hand protects Orgrimmar’s interests through secret intelligence and assassination. For a year, its members worked to place an agent in the Venture Company’s ranks. Taskmaster Fizzule earned a place at their drilling outpost north of Sludge Fen, among the company’s mercenaries.

Fizzule must keep his hard-edged reputation to satisfy the Venture Company’s overseers. An unexpected visitor could bring an attack. Rogues who reach his tower must fire two flares from the signaling gun within sight, approach quietly, and give the Shattered Hand’s secret salute. Then Fizzule can share what he has learned about the company’s growing schemes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Venture Company... Perhaps you have heard of them?
For one year we have worked on planting an agent deep within their ranks. Through much hard work and careful planning, we succeeded.
Recently we received word that the Venture Co. Are planning something on a grand scale. Go north of the Sludge Fen to the Venture Co. Tower and contact our undercover agent, Taskmaster Fizzule.
When you find the tower, use this flare gun, then approach Fizzule and show him the salute of the Shattered Hand.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It's good to see another agent of the Shattered Hand in these parts, however, the flare may have been a little too much!
Next time you need to speak with me, blow into this whistle twice and I'll know you are an ally.
